_comment: Video-specific edits to the article, applied by extract.mjs after parsing.
Keyed by slug, which comes from the article text and so survives renumbering.
Edits are regex substitutions, not whole rewrites: extract.mjs fails loudly if
a pattern stops matching, which is what happens when the article moves under it.
Kinds of edit: replace ([pattern, replacement, flags?]), topology (which diagram
to show), absorb (take another segment's visual and drop it), splitAt + pieces
(cut a paragraph in two), skip, and sections.<slug>.skip.
pronunciation: notes espeak-ng cannot supply, merged into PRONUNCIATION.md.
image: show a picture instead of a diagram.
credit: a line at the bottom of the frame. A run takes it from its first segment.
iris: shut the frame onto one element at the end, over the last second.
